passage.text: Booha goes to the station. He sees a car, a bus, and a taxi on the street. A bicycle and a motorcycle stop near the bus stop. A truck is big, but the police car is fast. An ambulance and a fire engine go past with loud sounds. At the station, Booha gets on a train. Later, he sees a boat on the river and an airplane in the sky.

comprehension.q: What does Booha see in the sky?

passage.text: Mimo has a map, but he does not know the way. Booha says, “Go straight on this street. Turn right at the corner and walk to the traffic light. Use the crosswalk there. The station is near the park and next to a shop. It is between the bank and the bus stop.” Mimo follows the directions. The station is not far, and he gets there in five minutes.

comprehension.q: What should Mimo use to cross the street?
How long does the walk take?

passage.text: Booha learns how to travel safely. In a car, he wears a seat belt. On a bicycle, he wears a helmet and rides on the road, not the sidewalk. At a crosswalk, he watches for pedestrians. At the station, he stands behind the yellow line and holds the handrail on the stairs. He reads every danger sign and knows where the first aid kit is. Booha carries his ID and knows the emergency number if he needs help.

comprehension.q: What does Booha wear on a bicycle?
Where does Booha stand at the station?

passage.text: Booha takes a train to the last station. He buys a round-trip ticket from the ticket machine and puts money on his IC card. The timetable shows a local train and an express train. Booha waits on platform three. He must transfer once, but an announcement says there is a delay. The departure is ten minutes late. When he finally arrives at the terminal, he checks the arrival time and keeps his ticket.

comprehension.q: Where does Booha buy his ticket?
